name: Ghost Robotics Vision 60
summary: A 51 kg IP67 quadruped built mainly for defence and security, rated -40 to 55 °C, walking about 3 hours with up to 10 kg of sensors.

germany.statusNote: Imported into Germany on request by ATC SiPro GmbH (Thuringia), which supplied Vision 60 units to the Bundeswehr in 2024; Ghost Robotics also takes requests directly. Focus is defence and security; no public euro price.

sellers.name: ATC SiPro GmbH
sellers.note: Importer; supplied four units to the German armed forces procurement office (BAAINBw) in 2024. Product page names defence, homeland security and enterprise use.

sellers.name: Ghost Robotics
sellers.note: Contact form lists construction and industrial as industries.

specs.label: Size (L x W x H standing)
Speed
specs.conditions: sprint; standard walk 0.9 m/s, fast walk 1.2 m/s

specs.label: Endurance
specs.conditions: continuous walking at 0.9 m/s, about 10 km; 21 h standby

specs.label: Operating temperature
specs.conditions: no cold start below -20 °C, no charging below 0 °C

specs.label: Integrated sensors
specs.value: 5 RGB cameras (1080p), 4 Intel D435 depth sensors, dual-antenna RTK GPS

specs.label: Payload options
specs.value: manipulator arm, security payload, lidar, low-light camera

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: NVIDIA Xavier, 32 GB RAM, 2 TB SSD

specs.label: APIs
specs.value: C/C++, ROS, ROS2, MAVLink, ATAK, JSON missions; simulator

notes: Marketed mainly for military, public safety and security; construction and industrial inspection are secondary markets.
Wireless charging station available for 24/7 operation.
Manipulator arm is an optional payload.
